origin.description: Replace Unicode code points one by one.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: One string of code points to replace.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: One string of replacement code points.

origin.details: If pattern and replacement have different numbers of code points, the extra code points are ignored and a warning is signaled. A repeated pattern code point keeps the last replacement. A missing pattern or replacement makes every result missing.

translation.description: Replace Unicode code points one by one.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: One string of code points to replace.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: One string of replacement code points.

translation.details: The map is built from the shared prefix of pattern and replacement. A repeated pattern code point keeps the last replacement. A length mismatch warns and drops the extra code points. A missing pattern or replacement makes every result missing. A missing string stays missing. The string "NA" is text.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list returns a list. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.trans import stri_trans_char
x = stri_trans_char("id.123", ".", "_")
print(f'stri_trans_char("id.123", ".", "_") returns {x}.')
